section.title: People & Tribal Knowledge
section.purpose: Capture authority, expertise, exceptions and human-only judgment.

questions.title: Operating roles
questions.prompt: What roles participate in sales, delivery, finance, operations, support and management?

questions.title: Process owners
questions.recommendation: Every automated workflow needs a human owner.

questions.title: Decision authority
questions.prompt: Who can approve prices, refunds, contracts, spending, public statements and policy changes?

questions.title: Tribal knowledge holders
questions.prompt: Which people know critical things that are not written down?

questions.title: Unwritten rules
questions.prompt: What does the team 'just know' to do that is absent from SOPs?
questions.recommendation: Ask for exceptions, VIP cases and workarounds.

questions.title: Key-person risk
questions.prompt: What stops or degrades if a specific person is unavailable for a week?

questions.title: External parties
questions.prompt: Which vendors, contractors, partners, advisors or regulators affect workflows?

questions.title: Human-only work
questions.prompt: Which decisions or interactions must remain human even if automation is possible?
questions.recommendation: Preserve legal approvals, trust and relationship work.
